Answer: B
Reason: The serial chest X-rays (Figures 1a-1c) demonstrate a cystic lesion in the right lung that has increased in size over time, indicating slow growth rather than rapid expansion or stability. The linear structure visible within the cyst (indicated by arrows in Figure 1b) represents an intracystic vessel, which is characteristically a dilated pulmonary vein in such congenital cystic malformations.
